trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. Completing three hops is correct behaviour, not premature or incomplete termination.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including Lorene Rogers and Ralph Hutchinson. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents including University of Texas at Austin founding information. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including additional UT Austin and football team documents. All three hops completed as specified.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents using the claim verbatim, finding relevant information about Lorene Rogers and Ralph Hutchinson. The summarizer correctly identified institutional distinctions between UT Austin and UT System. The query generator produced comprehensive queries attempting to resolve ambiguities. Hop 2 retrieved documents clarifying UT Austin's founding (1881) and Lorene Rogers' role. Hop 3 retrieved additional documents about UT Austin and football teams. All 24 documents were concatenated and returned as specified. The summaries noted factual discrepancies in the claim (institutional conflation, unverified System founding date), which is appropriate analysis but not a pipeline failure. The program has no verification stage or completeness check by design, so the absence of a final verdict is correct behavior. No generated step failed to execute its role, and all three retrievals completed.
